notes: Latency model (fitted on this core, mean |error| 0.6 cycles): 5 cycles when |dividend| < |divisor| (quotient 0); 7 cycles when the quotient is 1; otherwise 7 + round(bits(quotient)/2), i.e. the divider produces two quotient bits per cycle. Hence the extremes are: min 5 at dividend 0 or |dividend| < |divisor|; max 7+32 = 39 for the 64-bit unsigned variant (dividend 0xffffffffffffffff, divisor 1, measured 39) and 38 for the 64-bit signed variant (dividend 0x7fffffffffffffff, divisor 2, measured 38); the 32-bit variants top out at 7+16 = 23. Verified by direct measurement of the model-predicted extremal inputs, not by exhaustive search. mod uses the same divider, so the same model applies.
